# Check funding gap (Step 1 of Funding Logic)
# If we ONLY execute BUY and ADD decisions without any sells, what is the cash ratio?
buys_and_adds = []
for ticker, (inf, act, target_w) in inferences.items():
    if act in ("BUY", "ADD"):
        curr_w = holdings.get(ticker, {}).get("tradable_weight", 0.0)
        diff_w = target_w - curr_w
        buy_val = diff_w * nav
        buy_cost = buy_val * 1.001425
        buys_and_adds.append((ticker, inf, act, curr_w, target_w, buy_val, buy_cost))

total_buy_expenditure = sum(x[6] for x in buys_and_adds)
cash_after_buys_only = cash - total_buy_expenditure
cash_ratio_after_buys_only = cash_after_buys_only / nav

print(f"Initial Cash: {cash:,.2f} ({cash/nav:.4%})")
print(f"Total Buy Expenditure (incl. fee): {total_buy_expenditure:,.2f} ({total_buy_expenditure/nav:.4%})")
print(f"Cash after buys only: {cash_after_buys_only:,.2f} ({cash_ratio_after_buys_only:.4%})")
print("Target cash range: [0.15, 0.20]")
print("Is cash_ratio_after_buys_only < 0.15?", cash_ratio_after_buys_only < 0.15)

# Also calculate sells
sells = []
for ticker, (inf, act, target_w) in inferences.items():
    if act in ("TRIM", "SELL_ALL"):
        curr_w = holdings[ticker]["tradable_weight"]
        diff_w = curr_w - target_w
        sell_val = diff_w * nav
        sell_net = sell_val * (1 - 0.004425)
        sells.append((ticker, inf, act, curr_w, target_w, sell_val, sell_net))

total_sell_net = sum(x[6] for x in sells)
final_cash = cash - total_buy_expenditure + total_sell_net
print(f"Total Sell Net Proceeds: {total_sell_net:,.2f} ({total_sell_net/nav:.4%})")
print(f"Final Estimated Cash: {final_cash:,.2f} ({final_cash/nav:.4%})")
for b in buys_and_adds:
    print("BUY/ADD:", b[0], b[1], b[2], f"curr:{b[3]:.4f}->target:{b[4]:.4f}", f"cost:{b[6]:,.0f}")
for s in sells:
    print("SELL/TRIM:", s[0], s[1], s[2], f"curr:{s[3]:.4f}->target:{s[4]:.4f}", f"net:{s[6]:,.0f}")
